newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Mapfre sees excellent 1997 results.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Mapfre sees excellent 1997 results.

text.p: Spanish insurance group Corporacion Mapfre said on Thursday it is expecting excellent 1997 results after first quarter earnings and income outstripped expectations.

"First quarter data are very favourable, with both income and profits growing more than we anticipated," chief executive Manuel Martinez told journalists, adding that forecasts for this year's results are "excellent".
The firm is expecting strong growth in group life premiums and a return to profits in the international business after losses in that division of 329 million pesetas in 1996.
"This year our international business will see substantial profits, above 1995 levels (of 1.54 billion pesetas)," Martinez said.
Corporacion Mapfre posted net attributable profit of 9.74 billion pesetas in 1996 versus 9.57 billion the previous year.
